services.title: Website Development
services.shortDescription: Performance-focused websites and web apps engineered to convert visitors into loyal clients.
services.description: For businesses that require a fast, credible, and modern web presence. We build custom, performance-focused sites tailored to your brand identity and conversion goals — never templated or bloated. Ideal for founders, brands, and companies seeking top-tier SEO and lightning-fast load speeds.
features: Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals Optimization
services.deliverables: Production-ready website, CMS dashboard, automated deployments, SEO audit

services.title: Full Stack Development
services.shortDescription: Full-cycle SaaS and web applications built with robust APIs, secure auth, and scalable databases.
services.description: For products that need a real backend, not just a frontend. We design and construct the API, database schema, caching, and auth layer to reliably support your business logic as user traffic expands. Ideal for startups building their MVP from scratch.
services.deliverables: Full-stack web application, API documentation, database migrations, CI/CD pipeline

services.title: Mobile App Development
services.shortDescription: High-performance native-feeling mobile applications built for both iOS and Android from one unified codebase.
services.description: For businesses that need a native-feeling app without maintaining two separate codebases. Ideal for teams that want to ship to the App Store and Google Play quickly without compromising on fluid animations, security, or native device capabilities.
features: App Store & Google Play Store Submission
services.deliverables: Compiled iOS & Android app binaries, source repository, store release support

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.shortDescription: Conversion-focused, intuitive product designs and design systems validated with real user feedback.
services.description: For products where usability, intuitive navigation, and high conversion matter most. We design and validate flows before writing code, saving you expensive development pivots. Ideal for teams that have an idea or existing app that needs a professional UX overhaul.
services.deliverables: Full Figma design file, UI component kit, interactive prototype, developer handoff specs

services.title: Cloud Solutions
services.shortDescription: Auto-scaling, highly secure cloud infrastructure and continuous deployment pipelines.
services.description: For applications outgrowing single servers or manual deployments. We set up automated deployment pipelines, containerized environments, and cloud architecture that self-heals, scales with spikes, and maintains strict security standards.
services.deliverables: Automated deployment pipeline, infrastructure as code, monitoring dashboard, security report

services.title: AI & Machine Learning
services.shortDescription: Custom AI chatbots, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent workflow automation.
services.description: For workflows that are manual, repetitive, or data-intensive. We engineer purpose-built AI agents, automated document extractors, custom recommendation systems, and LLM integrations scoped to measurable ROI and business efficiency.
services.deliverables: Deployed AI microservice, vector search database, API endpoints, testing benchmarks
